decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area.)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The approved single storey side addition shall not be used as separate living accommodation or for business purposes, and the garage shall be retained as a domestic garage for use by the occupiers of No.16 Craneswater Park and used for no other purpose.

REASON:  To protect neighbouring residents' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - A 2 metre high screen shall be installed on the south side and for the full depth of the approved roof terrace, to prevent overlooking onto the adjoining property No. 1 The Glen. The screen shall be either solid or obscure glazed, or be a trellis, and be permanently retained as such.

REASON:  To protect neighbouring residents' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed extensions would not be harmful to neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the building and the surrounding area.  They are in line with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Demolition of existing outbuilding, erection of a two-storey side extension, part two-storey and part single storey rear extension, and single storey side extension.
